name: champ-spot-tool
description: Gainwell CHAMP · Spot Recognition Tool — WhatsApp-first, money-free peer recognition with a live feed, moderation console, analytics and plant boards

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build && npm run migrate -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web

comment:allowScripts: npm 12 blocks dependency install scripts unless they are listed here. esbuild's postinstall fetches its platform binary — without it `vite build` fails with 'You installed esbuild for another platform'. better-sqlite3's install script fetches its prebuilt native binding (local SQLite dev only; production uses mysql2). Name-only keys approve any version, so a dependency bump needs no re-approval. Older npm ignores this field.
